visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, straight black hair wearing a white blouse under a pink knitted vest sits at a black table, holding a fork with a piece of fried food. A young man with dark, styled hair wearing a black puffer jacket and a striped sweater sits beside her, holding a small white tissue pack and looking at her intently. The setting is a brightly lit indoor kitchen or living area with white cabinets and a refrigerator in the background. (2) The woman brings the food to her mouth while looking slightly nervous, and the man begins to pull a tissue from the pack, his eyes never leaving her face. She covers her mouth with her hand after taking a bite, appearing guilty or startled, while he continues to stare and manipulate the tissue. (3) The woman picks up a white mug with 'SPY x FAMILY' graphics and takes a drink, her eyes darting toward the camera. The man continues to watch her, his expression persistent as he puts a small piece of food in his mouth, chewing slowly while maintaining eye contact. (4) Suddenly, the woman stands up quickly and moves out of the frame to the left, leaving her food and mug behind. The man remains seated, looking surprised and turning his head to watch her leave while still chewing his snack.
